D16·2zpn — 2026-10-10
chose: 1.3 readiness: a queued task is ready when every waits_on handle resolves (SPEC §Links states; open, moved and dangling hold it). Home handles resolve from the fold; foreign handles from the links tier in the driver and `sofar next --ready`, and count as held on the fold-only hot path (statusline, prompt line, TS and Rust). A run whose queue holds only waiting tasks stops `closed` with a note naming each wait.
over: Ready when nothing is `open` (letting a dangling target through), reading other logs on the prompt path, or a new run stop reason
because: A dangling handle names a target that may not be written yet, and the write surfaces warn rather than refuse it on that reason. The prompt path cannot read another log, and a foreign wait still open is the common case, so counting it as held matches the driver for as long as it is open. A new stop reason would change the run_stopped schema and the Rust types for a note's worth of information.
